author: Petuch, 1987

note.en: A small olive snail listed by WoRMS for the Costa Rican Caribbean. It lives buried in sand and the only local record is one unverified iNaturalist photo near Limón, so it is a record.
note.es: Un caracol oliva pequeño que WoRMS registra para el Caribe de Costa Rica. Vive enterrado en la arena y el único registro local es una foto sin verificar de iNaturalist cerca de Limón, así que es solo un registro.

evidence: WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: iNaturalist: 1 unverified observation near Limón[^2].
